method: Depth search over all 311 distinct traces in the review app's live-Langfuse snapshot (loaded 2026-09-18), excluding all 62 already-reviewed trace IDs (including the 60 formal breadth samples). Retrieval used status/price prompt patterns and currency fields, answer word counts plus topic neighbors of human clarity notes, and final-assistant-message presence plus historical diagnostics. Manually selected 25 IDs for role/topic and boundary coverage: unsolicited_status_price 10, answer_obscured_by_excess_detail 9, missing_usable_final_response 6; 12 possible matches and 13 possible close negatives. Length, price strings, and diagnostics are search signals, not labels. Includes completed/incomplete attempts of three scenarios; final-229 has a reworded prompt, not an identical retry. Full per-trace reasons: analysis/state/depth_search_plan.json. No model calls. Student must review and accept/reject suggestions.

method_details.word_count: Whitespace-separated words in the last assistant text with no later tool call/result in the individual trace.
method_details.completion_signal: Presence of an assistant text message after the last tool activity; this is a retrieval heuristic, not a judgment of adequacy.
method_details.selection: Purposeful contrast selection by role, topic, and request boundary from the filtered/ranked results; no random draw and no LLM classification.

caveats: All hypotheses and close-negative candidates require human review.
Word count is not a quality threshold.
A missing-reply flag or provider diagnostic does not establish a model-behavior failure.
Source is the app's existing live-Langfuse snapshot, not a newly fetched production population.
Scenario IDs can repeat across distinct traces. The final-229 complete/incomplete pair has different wording.
Source excerpts are proposed evidence, not human annotations.
